svg.text: claudia — E2 round two: where each change goes (class diagram, proposed)
Branch e2-document-sec, on main at 518a7bf. Violet edge = new file or class, plain edge = changed. Nothing is built; this is for the architecture discussion.
+ a key pair per slot and for the recovery key
+ PrivateDomain(id): a key only in its person's slot
+ renew_keys(path, keys, domains) -> new keys, inbox entries
people list holds each person's public key
+ AuditRecord(kind, who, when, format, parts, pages)
+ append / read the audit chain (history key, own blocks)
not redactable; never part of the command log
+ write_export(state, history?, chat?, who, parts) -> bytes
zip: format, export.json, content.json, history.jsonl, chat.jsonl
+ the format specification (E2.1): manifest, slots, inbox,
chains, audit, private domains, limits; what is not detected (D1268)
+ check(address, doc, name) -> seconds to wait (0 = go on)
clock injected; memory only; forgets after 15 min (D1266)
+ measure_again(); target and ceiling from server settings
unknown event type -> editors and owners only
test: every `"type"` literal in the tree is classified
dispatch refuses a viewer for history/chat -> forbidden
+ set_role, export_claudia; export_content stays for Download
test: every method states what it reads
Gateway._hello asks LoginThrottle before any hashing
+ retry_after on refusal; client address per D1275
admin_api.py: the same throttle for the admin sign-in
+ set_role, remove_user -> renew_keys, inbox taken at login
+ record(AuditRecord) for exports (server) and prints (client report)
+ security: kdf target, memory ceiling, throttle numbers
+ wait state: message, countdown, disabled button (D1266)
+ viewer: one sentence instead of History & Chat
+ audit rows, muted, one line each (D1271)
+ role select per person; notice before a change
+ remove confirmation: keys renewed, private notes deleted
+ recognises the export zip, says so, takes name and password
authors of its history shown as former people (D1272)
+ Print… and Save PDF… call report_output when the
file is saved or the page sent (D1271)
+ role-aware: viewer gets no history/chat state; `sealed` text
+ `retry_after` handling for login and admin login
+ time, memory ceiling, measured, Measure again, wait numbers
claudia-core is not touched: the kernel stays free of roles and network code, so the audience table is in the server.
